verdict.rationale: Penpot's AI evidence is entirely about an MCP server that lets external AI agents/LLMs connect to Penpot's data (penpot-docs-1, penpot-docs-18, penpot-docs-27, penpot-docs-31, penpot-docs-39), not about a built-in AI assistant embedded in the product itself that users can delegate tasks to. No evidence describes an in-app AI chat/copilot feature within the Penpot UI.
